title: Data Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Data Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. Pipeline Design: Batch vs. streaming trade-offs (Spark, Flink, Kafka), pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Prefect), and idempotency in ETL/ELT jobs.
2. Data Modeling: Dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema), slowly changing dimensions, data vault concepts, and dbt transformations.
3. Storage & Query Engines: Data warehouse design (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake), partitioning, clustering, columnar storage, and query cost optimization.
4. Reliability & Governance: Data quality checks, lineage tracking, schema evolution handling, PII management, and SLA-aware pipeline monitoring.

sections.heading: Question Strategy
lines: - Do not use a fixed sequence. Choose the next question based on the candidate's latest answer quality and identified gaps.
- Pipeline reliability and data modeling choices are the highest-signal areas - probe the reasoning behind design decisions.
- Use interview difficulty to calibrate: ETL basics for entry-level, streaming architecture and cost/latency trade-offs for senior.
- Use resume and job-description signals to focus on the candidate's stack (Spark, dbt, Airflow, specific cloud warehouse).
- If no job description is provided, do not infer or fabricate JD-specific requirements.
- If the candidate is strong in one area, shift to another high-signal data engineering competency to broaden assessment.
